question.text: At <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1990</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>atm</mi></math> pressure, there are equal number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>Cl</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> molecules and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Cl</mi></math> atoms in the reaction mixture. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></msub></math> for the reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>Cl</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msub><mi>Cl</mi><mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></mfenced></msub></math> under the above conditions is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is______(Rounded off to the nearest integer)

solution.text:
Cl2⇌2Cl

Let mol of both of Cl2 and Cl is x

PCl=x2x×1=12 atm

PCl2=x2x×1=12 atm

Kp=12212=12=0.5⇒5×10-1
